english.title: Fail to provide facilities to inspect service charge information to freehold house purchaser
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person entitled to enforce payment of a service charge in respect of a house at **(..SPECIFY HOUSE ADDRESS..), and having supplied, pursuant to section 48(1) of the Housing Act 1985, a summary of costs in relation to service charges for the period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) to **(..SPECIFY PERSON LIABLE TO PAY..), the person liable to pay the said service charge, failed without reasonable excuse to provide reasonable facilities for the inspection of the accounts, receipts and other documents and to allow the taking of copies or extracts from them within one month of the request and for a period of two months thereafter
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 48(4) and 50 of the Housing Act 1985.
